name: step-explainer
title: Step Explainer
description: A how-to with three numbered steps. A line draws from one numbered circle to the next, each step appears in turn with a small drawn icon, a title and a short detail. Vertical in a portrait frame, horizontal in a landscape one. Steps and their icons come from one variable.
useWhen: How to order, how to join, how to claim: a three-step process.
A shop explaining its ordering flow.
avoidWhen: Showing the real ordering interface: use checkout-flow or scroll-menu-phone.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Steps
variables.description: Three lines, Title|Detail|icon. Icons: list, chat, box, card, clock, pin, check.
variables.default:
Pilih menu|Lihat katalog dan tentukan pesananmu|list
Kirim pesanan|Lewat chat, tanpa antre|chat
Terima di rumah|Dikirim di hari yang sama|box

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: The numbered circles: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
